Unit 5: Key Concepts

What you'll master this week

The Enablement Paradox

Why more content often means less seller confidence — and how AI solves the signal-to-noise problem.

From Artifacts → Intelligence

Static PDFs become living knowledge bases. Battlecards become real-time competitive coaching.

RAG-Powered Enablement

How retrieval-augmented generation creates personalized, contextual sales intelligence at scale.

The Three Layers

Knowledge Layer → Intelligence Layer → Delivery Layer. The stack that replaces the folder of PDFs.

Dynamic Battlecards

From quarterly updates to real-time competitive intelligence that surfaces when reps need it.

Measuring What Matters

From content downloads to influence on deals. New metrics for the intelligence era.

WAVE 1 · MONTHS 1-2

1. Messaging Drafter

Draft value propositions, positioning, and narratives from product specs — in SAP-approved frameworks.

WHAT IT DOES

Generates first-draft value propositions, messaging frameworks, and persona-specific narratives. Refines tone and repurposes across formats.

TRIGGER

User-led, reactive — PMM-invoked on demand.

TARGET KPI

Messaging draft cycle time · % drafts reused without rework

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Messaging frameworks, value propositions, persona definitions, approved narratives, content library

INTEGRATIONS

SharePoint, Seismic/Highspot, DAM

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
Messaging Framework Lab

Creates value propositions, 3 messaging pillars, persona variants, elevator pitches, objection handlers

✅ LIVE!
WAVE 1 · MONTHS 1-2

2. Pricing Approval Agent

Assemble pricing rationale and value framing to accelerate approval cycles.

WHAT IT DOES

Builds pricing rationale, value framing, and scenario summaries for approval workflow. Flags missing inputs and inconsistencies.

TRIGGER

User-led, reactive — with system-led prompts when approval cycle opens.

TARGET KPI

Pricing approval cycle time · first-pass approval rate

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Pricing guidance, offer structures, approval criteria, competitive price points

INTEGRATIONS

CLP, SharePoint, CRM

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
Pricing Rationale Builder

Executive summary, value waterfall, ROI analysis, cost of inaction, negotiation talking points

✅ LIVE!
WAVE 1 · MONTHS 1-2

3. Battlecard Refresh Agent

Keep battlecards current automatically from competitive signals.

WHAT IT DOES

Monitors competitive and analyst signals, drafts and refreshes battlecards. Flags material positioning changes for PMM review.

TRIGGER

System-led, proactive — on competitive signal; user-led on demand.

TARGET KPI

Battlecard freshness (days since update) · competitor coverage %

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Competitive-intel repositories, analyst reports, win/loss data, market research

INTEGRATIONS

Crayon, Analyst Portals, SharePoint, Seismic

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
BattleCoach

SAP vs. competition. Input deal briefing, get battle-ready artifacts via FUD Engine and proven frameworks.

✅ LIVE!
WAVE 2 · MONTHS 3-4

4. Launch Readiness Agent

Track launch deliverables, flag gaps, and draft the artifacts that close them.

WHAT IT DOES

Tracks launch deliverables against readiness milestones and flags gaps in real time. Drafts standard launch artifacts to close open items.

TRIGGER

System-led, proactive — milestone-triggered; user-led on demand.

TARGET KPI

Launch readiness lead time · % deliverables on time

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Launch frameworks, commercialization checklists, readiness milestones

INTEGRATIONS

CLP, Project Management Tools, SharePoint

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
Launch Planner

From idea to launch day. Complete Bill of Materials with T-minus timeline and task tracking.

✅ LIVE!
WAVE 2 · MONTHS 3-4

5. Enablement Bundler

Assemble region- and persona-tuned sales enablement kits.

WHAT IT DOES

Bundles enablement assets into region- and persona-tuned kits with talk tracks and recommended collateral. Tailors to buyer journey stage.

TRIGGER

User-led, reactive — PMM- or field-invoked.

TARGET KPI

Enablement kit build time · field asset adoption rate

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Enablement assets, sales-play templates, buyer journeys, persona/region tags

INTEGRATIONS

Seismic, Highspot, CRM, SharePoint

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
Enablement Lab

Executive summary, talk track, proof points, objection handlers, recommended assets, competitive positioning

✅ LIVE!
WAVE 2 · MONTHS 3-4

6. Customer Reference Matcher

Match opportunities to references and draft case-study content.

WHAT IT DOES

Matches open opportunities to relevant customer references by industry, use case, and region. Drafts case-study and proof-point content.

TRIGGER

System-led, proactive — on new opportunity; user-led on demand.

TARGET KPI

Reference match rate · time-to-reference

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Reference database, opportunity data, case studies, customer profiles

INTEGRATIONS

CRM, Reference Management, SharePoint

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
Reference Matcher

Match opportunities to relevant references, draft case-study content

🔧 IN DEVELOPMENT
WAVE 3 · MONTHS 5-6

7. GEO Optimizer Agent

Scan content for AI-discoverability and recommend optimizations.

WHAT IT DOES

Scans content for generative-engine discoverability and citation readiness. Recommends structure and language changes for AI systems.

TRIGGER

System-led, proactive — periodic scan; user-led on demand.

TARGET KPI

AI-citation share · GEO score uplift

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Content corpus, AI-search/citation signals, GEO and SEO metrics

INTEGRATIONS

Web analytics, content platforms, LLM evaluation

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
GEO Visibility Test

GEO score 1-10, specificity analysis, quick wins, rewrite examples, test queries

✅ LIVE!
WAVE 3 · MONTHS 5-6

8. Content Localization Agent

Adapt approved content across regions and languages — brand-safe.

WHAT IT DOES

Adapts approved content across regions and languages with brand-safety and regulatory guardrails. Preserves messaging intent while localizing.

TRIGGER

User-led, reactive — PMM- or region-invoked.

TARGET KPI

Localization turnaround · brand-compliance rate

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Source content, brand guidelines, locale glossaries, regulatory rules

INTEGRATIONS

TMS, DAM, SharePoint

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
Content Localizer

Localized content, cultural context notes, terminology mapping, tone adjustments, compliance flags

✅ LIVE!
WAVE 3 · MONTHS 5-6

9. Win/Loss Synthesizer

Surface win/loss patterns and recommend positioning shifts.

WHAT IT DOES

Synthesizes win/loss records and deal notes into pattern reports. Recommends positioning shifts and messaging adjustments grounded in outcomes.

TRIGGER

System-led, proactive — periodic synthesis.

TARGET KPI

Win-rate insight cycle · positioning actions taken

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Win/loss records, CRM outcomes, deal notes, competitive data

INTEGRATIONS

CRM, Win/Loss Systems, SharePoint

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
Win/Loss Analyzer

Pattern reports, positioning recommendations, competitive insights

🔧 IN DEVELOPMENT
WAVE 3 · MONTHS 5-6

10. Pipeline Influence Tracker

Attribute content engagement to pipeline influence.

WHAT IT DOES

Connects content engagement to pipeline and opportunity outcomes. Quantifies PMM influence on revenue to inform investment decisions.

TRIGGER

System-led, proactive — continuous.

TARGET KPI

Content-influenced pipeline (€) · attribution coverage

DATA REQUIREMENTS

Content engagement, pipeline/opportunity data, attribution models

INTEGRATIONS

SAP Analytics Cloud, CRM, web analytics

🧪 LAB PROTOTYPE
Pipeline Tracker

Attribution reports, investment recommendations, ROI analysis
